name: Sinotruk (Hong Kong) Limited
summary: Sinotruk (Hong Kong) Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focused on the design, production, and distribution of a diverse range of vehicles. This includes heavy-duty, medium-heavy, and light-duty trucks, as well as buses and their associated components, serving markets both in Mainland China and internationally. The company's operations are divided into four main segments: Heavy Duty Trucks, Light Duty Trucks and Other Vehicles, Engines, and Financial Services. Its product offerings encompass specialized vehicles, engines for industrial and construction machinery, power units for heavy and light-duty trucks, and crucial heavy-duty truck assemblies like gearboxes, various castings and forgings, cabins, axles, and steel frames. Beyond manufacturing, Sinotruk provides services such as axle and transmission component supply, vehicle customization (truck refitting), and a comprehensive suite of financial solutions. These financial offerings include deposit services, various lending options (such as auto and supply chain financing, entrusted loans), bill discounting, and customer credit. The company also offers general loans and strategic consulting. Additionally, it handles the import and export of trucks and spare parts, engages in engine manufacturing and refurbishment, and conducts ongoing research, development, production, and sale of commercial vehicles. Sinotruk's extensive client base spans industries such as infrastructure development, construction, container transportation, logistics, mining, steel production, and chemical processing. Established in 2007, the company is headquartered in Jinan, China, and functions as a subsidiary of China National Heavy Duty Truck Group Company Limited.
